name: Balance Amounts 2
definition: Amounts linked to a securities balance, for example, holding value.

HoldingValue.name: Holding Value
HoldingValue.definition: Value of an individual financial instrument holding within a safekeeping account.

BookValue.name: Book Value
BookValue.definition: Value of a financial instrument, as booked/acquired in an account. It may be used to establish capital gain tax liability.

UnrealisedGainLoss.name: Unrealised Gain Loss
UnrealisedGainLoss.definition: Difference between holding value and the book value.
